description: Source code for a C++ class 'TypeParser' that parses Python-like type strings into internal type representations for PyTorch JIT mobile runtime, including support for custom and nested types.

classes.name: TypeParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing Python-like type strings into internal PyTorch type representations, supporting nested, custom, and special types.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the current token stream into a PyTorch type object.

methods.name: parseList
methods.description: Parses a list of Python type strings into a vector of type objects.

methods.name: getNonSimpleType
methods.description: Returns the set of non-simple type names supported.

methods.name: getCustomType
methods.description: Returns the set of custom type names supported.

methods.name: getContainedTypes
methods.description: Returns the set of types contained within a parsed type string.

methods.name: parseNonSimple
methods.description: Parses non-simple types like List, Optional, Dict, Tuple.

methods.name: parseCustomType
methods.description: Parses custom types, including NamedTuple and other user-defined classes.
